title: Tensor scalar extension of the structure algebra on a fibred groupoid
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $R$ a commutative $k$-algebra, and $\mathcal X$ a category fibred in groupoids over $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids] [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $\phi:\mathcal X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a morphism over $k$, and let $C$ be a commutative $R$-algebra. Use the big fppf structure sheaf and compatible-family global section rings of [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra]. The tensor extension $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}\otimes_R C$ [def-weil-module-base-change] is the associated ring sheaf of the pointwise pushout of $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}\leftarrow\underline R\to\underline C$, where underlines denote constant presheaves and the left arrow is structural pullback along $\phi$. On an affine test $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\mathcal X$ it is the algebra associated to $A\otimes_R C$. Its $\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}$-algebra structure is the left pushout leg, and the right leg defines the canonical ring homomorphism $u:C\to\Gamma(\mathcal X,\mathcal O_{\mathcal X}\otimes_R C)$ sending $c$ to the compatible section family $1\otimes c$. Give this global section ring its $C$-algebra structure through $u$. Structural pullback commutes with every arrow of the total category. Canonical universe lifts of coefficient rings preserve these constructions.
